name: ai.easybook/booking
title: EasyBook
description: Find businesses, see free times and book, reschedule or cancel appointments on EasyBook.

tools.name: book_appointment
tools.description: Books what review_booking priced, exactly as reviewed, once the person agreed to that review; a card showing the review may book it itself and report the outcome to your context. Answers the booking: appointmentCode, status (REQUESTED when the business still has to accept it, then awaitingBusiness is true; CONFIRMED when it is booked), title, start and end time with the venue's timezone, venue with its city, cover image, address and map link, staff member, amountTotal and amountDue to pay at the venue, and url, its page on EasyBook. Calling it again with the same confirmation books nothing twice and answers the same booking. If the time was taken, the price changed or the person's bookings changed since the review, nothing is booked: review it again.

tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancels the booking review_cancellation reviewed, exactly as reviewed, once the person agreed to that review; a card showing the review may cancel it itself and report the outcome to your context. Answers appointmentCode, status CANCELLED and the outcome (refund, fee, strike, pass uses returned, as review_cancellation described them); alreadyCancelled is true, with no outcome, when the booking was already cancelled another way; and url, its page on EasyBook. Calling it again with the same confirmation cancels nothing twice. If the booking or what cancelling gives back changed since the review, nothing is cancelled: review it again.

tools.name: reschedule_booking
tools.description: Moves the booking review_reschedule reviewed, exactly as reviewed, once the person agreed to that review; call review_reschedule first. A card showing the review may move it itself and report the outcome to your context. Answers the moved booking: appointmentCode, status (REQUESTED when the business has to accept the move, then awaitingBusiness is true; CONFIRMED when it is moved), title, the new start and end time with its timezone, venue, staff member and url, its page on EasyBook. If the booking, the fee or whether the business must accept changed since the review, nothing is moved: review it again. Calling it again with the same confirmation never moves it twice and answers the booking where it was moved.

tools.name: review_booking
tools.description: Prices a booking of one service at a venue at one start time for this person, without booking anything: core checks the time is free and the business takes the booking online. Answers each priced line (name, quantity, unit price, total, discount, and passCoverage FULL when a pass of theirs covers it), amountTotal for the whole booking and amountDue after what a pass covers, as minorUnits with the currency's scale, to be paid at the venue (nothing is charged online), each appointment line's duration in minutes, the venue (name, address, city, timezone, cover image, logo), the staff member asked for, the booking policy this service is booked under as plain-language terms with their group (and lateCancellationCosts, true when cancelling late costs money or prepaid credit), and a confirmation. Show the person the price and terms and let them confirm, in the card or in chat. Pass the confirmation unchanged to book_appointment only once they agree to this review; a new review needs new agreement. When the card is shown they may finish there, so read the outcome from your context before asking again. It expires after a few minutes.

startTime.description: The start time, an ISO-8601 date-time with offset exactly as find_free_times answered it

staffAccountCode.description: The staff member's accountCode, from find_free_times or get_business; leave it out for whoever is free

notes.description: What the person wants the business to know, at most 500 characters

tools.name: review_cancellation
tools.description: Tells what cancelling one of this person's own bookings right now would do, without cancelling it, under the terms it was booked under: refundPercentage, until when cancelling gives everything back (fullRefundUntil, when the terms set one), the late fee, whether prepaid credit is forfeited or a strike is recorded, what was paid, what would be refunded, and how many pass uses come back, money as minorUnits with the currency's scale; plus a confirmation. Refused when the booking can no longer be cancelled. Show the person what they get back and what it costs and let them confirm, in the card or in chat. Pass the confirmation unchanged to cancel_booking only once they agree to this review; a new review needs new agreement. When the card is shown they may finish there, so read the outcome from your context before asking again. It expires after a few minutes.

appointmentCode.description: The booking's appointmentCode, from list_my_bookings or get_booking

reason.description: Why the person cancels, for the business, at most 500 characters

tools.name: review_reschedule
tools.description: Tells what moving one of this person's own bookings to a new start time would do, without moving it, under the terms it was booked under: the current and the new start and end time with the booking's timezone, status (REQUESTED when the business has to accept the move, then awaitingBusiness is true; CONFIRMED when it is moved at once), the staff member, any fee the move adds (fees, each with its reason, such as LATE_RESCHEDULE, and amountDue as minorUnits with the currency's scale, to be paid at the venue), url, its page on EasyBook, and a confirmation. find_free_times shows what is free. Refused when the time is taken, the booking already started or was cancelled, or its terms no longer allow a move. Show the person the new time and any fee and let them confirm, in the card or in chat. Pass the confirmation unchanged to reschedule_booking only once they agree to this review; a new review needs new agreement. When the card is shown they may finish there, so read the outcome from your context before asking again. It expires after a few minutes.

appointmentCode.description: The booking's appointmentCode, from list_my_bookings or get_booking

startTime.description: The new start time, an ISO-8601 date-time with offset exactly as find_free_times answered it

tools.name: get_booking
tools.description: Gets one booking by appointmentCode: title, business organizationCode, start and end time with its timezone, status, this person's own response to it, the staff member, where it is held (VENUE, ADDRESS or ONLINE, with the venue, its city, cover image, address and map link, or the meeting link), notes, each booked service with its time, staff and price (one entry per unit taken: one price for everyone it seats), attendee names, payment (list total, discount, settled and due, as minorUnits with the currency's scale), the booking policy it was made under when it is this person's own booking, until when it can be cancelled or rescheduled, free of charge and at all, and url, its page on EasyBook.

appointmentCode.description: The booking's appointmentCode, from list_my_bookings, list_my_calendar_events or get_schedule

tools.name: list_my_bookings
tools.description: Lists the bookings this person made as a customer at any business: one-to-one appointments and seats in classes or events. UPCOMING lists those starting now or later, soonest first; PAST those that already started, most recent first. Each has its appointmentCode, title, business organizationCode, start and end time, the timezone it is held in, status (REQUESTED, CONFIRMED, DECLINED, CANCELLED, COMPLETED or NO_SHOW), the staff member, venue with its city, cover image, address and map link, services with their price, payment (list total, discount, settled and due, as minorUnits with the currency's scale), until when it can be cancelled, free of charge and at all, and url, its page on EasyBook. Results come a page at a time; page and totalPages say whether to ask for the next page. Use get_booking with an appointmentCode for the full booking.

period.description: UPCOMING for bookings still ahead, PAST for those already started

page.description: Zero-based page number; leave it out for the first page

tools.name: list_my_calendar_events
tools.description: Lists this person's calendar: their own events, their bookings and the connected calendars they show. Give either from and to, at most 92 days apart, for the events in that range with recurring ones expanded, earliest first; or query alone, 2 to 100 characters matched against title, location and description across all dates, latest first. Never both. Each event has its title, kind (PERSONAL, BOOKING, BLOCK or CLOSURE), status (CONFIRMED, TENTATIVE or CANCELLED), start and end time, whether it is all day, timezone, location, description, meeting link, the connected calendar it comes from, organizer, this person's response and the number of attendees. A booking carries the appointmentCode get_booking takes. Results come a page at a time; page and totalPages say whether to ask for the next page.

from.description: Start of the range, as an ISO-8601 date-time with offset, for example 2026-11-20T00:00:00+01:00; events ending after it are included

to.description: End of the range, as an ISO-8601 date-time with offset; events starting before it are included

query.description: Text to search for instead of a range

page.description: Zero-based page number; leave it out for the first page

tools.name: find_businesses
tools.description: Finds businesses on EasyBook that a person can book with, by what they are looking for, industry, city or nearness to a place. Each result is one venue (a business's location) with its venueCode, organizationCode, name, industries, address, rating, whether it takes online bookings, distance in km when searching near a place, and the services that matched the search with their serviceCode and price as minorUnits with the currency's scale. Pass the venueCode to get_business for its services, staff and booking policy. Results come a page at a time; page and totalPages say whether to ask for the next page. Needs no access to this person's data.

query.description: What the person is looking for, for example a service or business name, at least 2 characters; leave it out to browse by the filters alone

industryCode.description: An EasyBook industry code in capitals, for example BARBERSHOP or HAIR_SALON

city.description: The city's name, for example Tirana

latitude.description: Latitude of the place to search near, given with longitude

longitude.description: Longitude of the place to search near, given with latitude

radiusKm.description: How far from latitude and longitude to search, in km, at most 100; leave it out for 25

page.description: Zero-based page number; leave it out for the first page

tools.name: find_free_times
tools.description: Finds the times one service can be booked at a venue between two dates, at most 90 days apart: the venue's name, the service's name and duration in minutes, and for each day with a free time the staff members free then, each with their accountCode, name, photo, rating and review count, and the start times they can take, as ISO-8601 date-times with their UTC offset; timezone is the venue's, for telling the person the local time. Days and staff with nothing free are left out. Needs no access to this person's data.

from.description: The first day to look at, as an ISO-8601 date in the venue's timezone, for example 2026-11-20; not in the past

to.description: The last day to look at, as an ISO-8601 date; leave it out for a week from the first day

staffAccountCode.description: Only times this staff member is free; their accountCode from get_business

tools.name: get_business
tools.description: Shows one bookable venue on EasyBook: its name, description, industries, address, timezone, phone number, rating, whether it takes online bookings, opening hours per day of the week in the venue's timezone, the services it offers (serviceCode, name, kind, delivery, duration in minutes, price as minorUnits with the currency's scale, and whether a booking waits for the business to confirm it), its staff with their accountCode, and its booking policy as plain-language terms. Pass a serviceCode and optionally an accountCode to find_free_times. Needs no access to this person's data.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Searches EasyBook's public documentation for how to do something in EasyBook: setting up a business, services, staff, bookings, payments and the other features. Returns the best-matching documentation sections, each with its title, heading, product, url and content; answer from the content and cite the url. Needs no access to this person's data.

query.description: The question or keywords to search for, 1 to 300 characters

language.description: The language the question is written in, one of en, sq, it, de, es, el, fr, pt, nl, mk, bg; leave it out for en

industry.description: The kind of business the question is about, one of barbershop, hair-salon, hair-stylist, nail-salon, spa-wellness, physiotherapy, fitness-studio, dental-clinic, medical-clinic, consulting, tutoring-education, tattoo-studio; leave it out to search every industry
